items.title: Notifications
items.description: View the list of notifications with their Read or Unread status, and mark all of them as read at once.
items.rationale: The 'Notifications' heading combined with the 'Mark all read', 'Read', and 'Unread' badges most drove the goal-shaped name.

items.title: Projects
items.description: View the list of projects with owner, deadline, and status information, filter the list by searching, and drill into a project's detail page.
items.rationale: The 'Projects' heading plus 'Filter projects' search field drove the goal-shaped name.

items.title: About FlowProbe
items.description: An overview of the FlowProbe application, introducing its purpose and highlighting key screens such as the team dashboard, profile, and settings pages.
items.rationale: The 'About FlowProbe' heading and nav label directly frame this group as an informational section rather than a task flow.

items.title: Team dashboard
items.description: An overview of the team dashboard available at /flowprobe-screenshot-app/dashboard.
items.rationale: Driven by the screen at `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/dashboard` (headings: Team Dashboard).

items.title: Settings
items.description: The settings page at /flowprobe-screenshot-app/settings for managing account preferences.
items.rationale: Driven by the screen at `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/settings` (headings: Preferences).

items.title: Team
items.description: Browse the team page to view each member's name, presence status (Active, Away, Offline), role, and the projects they own, with a + Invite action to add new teammates.
items.rationale: Driven by the screen at `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/team`, `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/team/1` (headings: Team, Projects owned).

items.title: Team details
items.description: View the team page for team 1 at /flowprobe-screenshot-app/team/1.
items.rationale: Only evidence is the candidate page path '/flowprobe-screenshot-app/team/1', so the name reflects the team page entity.

items.title: A tiny, no-login app for testing docs generation
items.description: A tiny, no-login web app for trying out documentation generation from a web application's user flows.
headings: A tiny, no-login app for testing docs generation
items.rationale: Driven by the screen at `/flowprobe-screenshot-app/`, `/flowprobe-screenshot-app` (headings: A tiny, no-login app for testing docs generation).

items.title: Candidate profile page
items.description: View a candidate's profile page, including their name, Profile badge, and team information.
items.rationale: The 'Profile' page label and heading 'Jordan Rivera' drove the name; the team.json endpoint supports including team details in the view.

items.title: Create a new report
items.description: Start a new report by opening the Create Report screen, entering a report title, and selecting Next to begin building it.
items.rationale: The heading 'Create a new report' and page name 'Create Report' directly state the user's job.

items.title: Invite a team member
items.description: Use the /flowprobe-screenshot-app/invite page to send a teammate an invitation with a role, seat limit, access expiry date, and welcome message.
items.rationale: The heading 'Invite a team member' and the 'Invite Member' badge directly name this user goal.
